rationale: Price has already pulled back ~10% from the session high and is sitting at 40% of the day's range with sharply declining volume over the last five candles (25K → 3.7K shares), suggesting the initial momentum is exhausted without a clear new directional catalyst. The 131.6 bps spread on a $0.05 ATR instrument means the cost to enter and exit nearly consumes a full average candle range, making any tight risk-managed trade structurally disadvantaged. No news catalyst is identified, so the large gap is unexplained, and without a defined driver I have no reliable basis to favor continuation short toward session VWAP or a long reversal back toward the high.
